decoded.meaning: VALUE{ u8 0x00 } — RFC-0014 §3/§4: a connection vertex's value IS its link-liveness state, and DORMANT is 0x00. These are the bytes a freshly created engine-managed DIAL connection holds, and the bytes a read or a subscribe on /net/<module>/<name> carries.

link_state_encoding.note: RFC-0014 §4's enum table, in table order, from zero. The RFC deferred these byte values under the clause-kind rule; this vector plus the shipped link_state_t make them normative. Six values and no seventh — in particular there is NO `healing` state (§4's prose names one, which no enumerator has ever had; the retry state is RECONNECTING 0x02, corrected by the RFC-0014 errata batch, PR #1475).
link_state_encoding.0x00: DORMANT — DIAL: vertex exists; no socket (refcount 0). 0x00 is a migration constraint: it is the falsy default the superseded binary set_link_state(name, bool) used for `down`.
link_state_encoding.0x01: DIALING — DIAL: a connect attempt is in flight (first-ever or resumed)
link_state_encoding.0x02: RECONNECTING — DIAL: retrying toward UP between backoff waits
link_state_encoding.0x04: LISTENING — LISTEN: listen socket bound and accepting (0 or more peers)
link_state_encoding.0x05: BIND_FAILED — LISTEN: the listen socket could not bind

decoded.note: The codec tier cannot falsify the mapping above: a 1-byte VALUE round-trips in any core whatever the byte means to it. The mapping is bound in core/tests/link_liveness_test.cpp — test_conformance_vectors drives a live connection vertex through all six states through the production doors and reads the published byte back off graph_t::read.
